# FET Black Tie Event — Full Documentation

> The Night of Excellence — University of Buea Faculty of Engineering & Technology Black Tie Gala on 4 July 2026 at Amelia Apart Hotel, Bokwai-Buea.

---

## 1. Overview

The FET Black Tie Event is a formal gala organised by the University of Buea's Faculty of Engineering & Technology (FET). It is the faculty's flagship social event, bringing together students, alumni, faculty members, and distinguished guests for an evening of celebration, networking, live entertainment, and fine dining.

The event is managed through a modern web application that handles ticket sales, payment processing, QR-based check-in, and a real-time digital shout-out wall.

---

## 2. Event Details

- **Name:** FET Black Tie Event
- **Tagline:** The Night of Excellence
- **Date:** 4 July 2026
- **Time:** 6:00 PM (WAT / UTC+1)
- **Venue:** Amelia Apart Hotel, Bokwai-Buea, Cameroon
- **Dress Code:** Corporate
- **Organiser:** University of Buea — Faculty of Engineering & Technology
- **Contact:** 676 658 443
- **Website:** https://fet-black-tie.mybrainboostapp.com

## 3. Ticket Tiers & Pricing

All prices are in XAF (Central African CFA franc).

| Tier             | Price    | Seats | Category |
|------------------|----------|-------|----------|
| Classic          | 5,000    | 1     | Standard |
| Classic Couple   | 9,000    | 2     | Standard |
| VIP Classic      | 10,000   | 1     | VIP      |
| VIP Couple       | 18,000   | 2     | VIP      |
| Table of 5       | 30,000   | 5     | Table    |
| Table of 5 VIP   | 50,000   | 5     | Table    |
| Table of 10      | 100,000  | 10    | Table    |

**Booking deadline:** 30 June 2026, 11:59 PM (WAT). Online booking closes automatically after this date.

**Payment:** Processed via Fapshi, supporting Mobile Money (MTN) and Orange Money.

---

## 4. Application Pages

### 4.1 Home Page (`/`)
The main landing page featuring:
- Hero section with event branding and tagline
- Live countdown timer to the event date
- Event details (date, time, venue, dress code)
- Ticket tier cards with pricing
- Booking form for ticket reservation
- University and faculty logos

### 4.2 Send a Shout-out (`/message`)
A form where anyone can submit an anonymous message (shout-out) to be displayed on the live wall during the event. Messages are moderated by staff before appearing.

### 4.3 The Wall (`/board`)
A real-time display board that projects approved shout-outs during the gala. Messages cycle automatically and are designed for projection on large screens.

### 4.4 Ticket Confirmation (`/confirmation/[orderId]`)
Shown after a successful booking. Displays the ticket details, QR code, and confirmation of the reservation. This is a per-user dynamic page.

### 4.5 Ticket Check (`/checkin/[slug]`)
A read-only page linked from each ticket's QR code. Shows the ticket's validity status (paid, used, unknown) without consuming entry slots. Used by guests to verify their ticket.

### 4.6 Staff Sign-in (`/auth`)
Authentication page for event staff. Only staff members with valid credentials can access admin features.

### 4.7 Admin Dashboard (`/admin`)
Protected area for event organisers:
- **Orders** (`/admin`): View and manage all ticket bookings
- **Staff** (`/admin/staff`): Manage staff accounts and permissions
- **Messages** (`/admin/messages`): Moderate shout-out submissions (approve/reject)
- **Scan** (`/admin/scan`): QR code scanner for door entry — burns ticket slots upon scan

---

## 5. Technical Architecture

### 5.1 Stack
- **Framework:** Next.js 15 (App Router)
- **Language:** TypeScript
- **Styling:** Tailwind CSS with custom design tokens
- **UI Components:** shadcn/ui
- **Database:** PostgreSQL via Prisma ORM
- **Authentication:** Custom staff auth
- **Payment:** Fapshi API (Mobile Money / Orange Money)
- **Deployment:** Lovable platform (fet-black-tie.lovable.app)

### 5.2 Key Design Tokens
- Primary background: `#0A0A0E` (near-black)
- Accent: Gold (`var(--color-gold)`)
- Typography: Bebas Neue (display), Anton (headlines), Pinyon Script (script), DM Sans (body)

### 5.3 Database Models (Prisma)
- **Order**: Represents a ticket purchase (buyer name, phone, tier, payment status)
- **Ticket**: Individual entry passes linked to an order (unique slug, QR code, usage status)
- **Message**: Shout-out submissions (content, approval status, timestamps)
- **Staff**: Admin/staff user accounts

### 5.4 API Routes
- `POST /api/public/webhooks/fapshi`: Payment webhook from Fapshi — updates order payment status
- `GET /api/public/cron/reconcile`: Cron endpoint to reconcile pending payments

### 5.5 SEO & Discoverability
- **robots.ts**: Next.js metadata API — allows public pages, blocks admin/auth/dynamic routes
- **sitemap.ts**: XML sitemap listing the 3 public pages with priorities
- **Metadata**: Per-page title, description, OpenGraph, and Twitter Card tags
- **llms.txt**: Structured summary for AI/LLM crawlers
- **llms-full.txt**: Comprehensive documentation for AI systems

---

## 6. User Flows

### 6.1 Ticket Booking Flow
1. Visitor lands on homepage (`/`)
2. Reviews event details and ticket tiers
3. Fills in the booking form (name, phone, tier selection)
4. Submits the form — an order is created in the database
5. Payment is initiated via Fapshi (Mobile Money prompt)
6. On successful payment, the webhook confirms the order
7. User is redirected to confirmation page (`/confirmation/[orderId]`)
8. A QR code is generated linking to `/checkin/[slug]`

### 6.2 Event Entry Flow
1. Guest presents their QR code (printed or on phone) at the door
2. Staff opens the scanner (`/admin/scan`)
3. Scanner reads the QR code and navigates to `/checkin/[slug]`
4. Staff verifies the ticket status (paid, not yet used)
5. Upon entry, the scanner "burns" a slot — marking the ticket as used
6. For table bookings, multiple scans are needed (one per seat)

### 6.3 Shout-out Flow
1. Anyone visits `/message`
2. Writes an anonymous shout-out message
3. Submits the form — message enters the moderation queue
4. Staff reviews messages in `/admin/messages`
5. Approved messages appear on `/board` in real-time
6. The wall is projected on screens during the event
